images.what: Hubble 2018 image of the young oxygen-rich supernova remnant 1E 0102.2-7219 in the Small Magellanic Cloud: the remnant is the small blue filament ring near the bottom-centre; the big pink cloud top-right is the unrelated star-forming nebula N 76. Possible stand-in for Cassiopeia A in a 'death of a star' story

images.licence: Public domain (NASA)
